# Blitz

Source: https://blitz.hexdocs.pm/Blitz.md

# `Blitz`
[🔗](https://github.com/nshkrdotcom/blitz/blob/main/lib/blitz.ex#L1)

Lightweight parallel command execution for Elixir tooling.

`Blitz` runs isolated OS commands with bounded concurrency and prefixes
streamed output with a stable command id so parallel logs remain readable.

For config-driven Mix monorepos, see `Blitz.MixWorkspace`.

# `command`

```elixir
@type command() :: Blitz.Command.t()
```

# `run_option`

```elixir
@type run_option() ::
  {:announce?, boolean()}
  | {:max_concurrency, pos_integer()}
  | {:prefix_output?, boolean()}
  | {:timeout, timeout()}
```

# `command`

```elixir
@spec command(keyword() | map()) :: Blitz.Command.t()
```

Builds a `%Blitz.Command{}` from a keyword list or map.

# `run`

```elixir
@spec run([command()], [run_option()]) ::
  {:ok, [Blitz.Result.t()]} | {:error, Blitz.Error.t()}
```

Runs commands in parallel and returns their results.

# `run!`

```elixir
@spec run!([command()], [run_option()]) :: [Blitz.Result.t()]
```

Runs commands in parallel and raises if any command fails.

# Blitz.MixWorkspace

Source: https://blitz.hexdocs.pm/Blitz.MixWorkspace.md

# `Blitz.MixWorkspace`
[🔗](https://github.com/nshkrdotcom/blitz/blob/main/lib/blitz/mix_workspace.ex#L1)

Config-driven runner for Mix-oriented multi-project workspaces.

Workspace configuration lives in the root project's `mix.exs` under the
`:blitz_workspace` key. `Blitz.MixWorkspace` expands the configured project
patterns, builds isolated child `mix` commands, and runs staged workspace
tasks through `Blitz`.

Parallelism stays workspace-owned:

- `base` config describes task weight
- `multiplier` describes machine size
- `:auto` multiplier mode scales from local schedulers and memory
- per-task overrides and CLI `-j` still take precedence when present

# `runner_args`

```elixir
@type runner_args() :: [String.t()]
```

# `stage`

```elixir
@type stage() :: %{
  task: task_name(),
  commands: [Blitz.Command.t()],
  max_concurrency: pos_integer()
}
```

# `task_name`

```elixir
@type task_name() :: atom()
```

# `workspace_config`

```elixir
@type workspace_config() :: keyword() | map()
```

# `autodetect_multiplier`

```elixir
@spec autodetect_multiplier(keyword()) :: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 6
```

Returns a recommended workspace multiplier for the current machine.

Auto mode uses the lower of a CPU-derived class and a memory-derived class so
heavy Mix tasks do not scale only on one axis. Pass `:schedulers_online` and
`:memory_bytes` to make detection deterministic in tests or custom tooling.

# `command_env`

```elixir
@spec command_env(workspace_config(), String.t(), task_name()) :: [
  {String.t(), String.t() | nil}
]
```

Builds environment overrides for a project/task pair.

# `hashed_project_name`

```elixir
@spec hashed_project_name(String.t(), String.t(), keyword()) :: String.t()
```

# `load!`

Loads and normalizes workspace configuration from the current Mix project.

```elixir
  pos_integer()
```

Returns workspace project paths in stable configured order.

# `resolve_task_name!`


Resolves a CLI task name against the configured workspace tasks.


Returns the normalized workspace root for the current Mix project.


Returns the normalized workspace root from a workspace config.

# `run!`

```elixir

```

Runs a configured workspace task for the current Mix project.

# `run!`

```elixir
@spec run!(workspace_config(), task_name(), [String.t()]) :: :ok
```

Runs a configured workspace task.

# Blitz.MixWorkspace.Impact

Source: https://blitz.hexdocs.pm/Blitz.MixWorkspace.Impact.md

# `Blitz.MixWorkspace.Impact`
[🔗](https://github.com/nshkrdotcom/blitz/blob/main/lib/blitz/mix_workspace/impact.ex#L1)

Impact-aware execution for `Blitz.MixWorkspace`.

This layer computes deterministic task state for each planned workspace
command, skips exact states that already have a passed result, and persists
command results under `.blitz/test_state_v1`.

# `task_spec`

```elixir
@type task_spec() ::
  atom() | {atom(), [String.t()]} | {atom(), [String.t()], keyword()}
```

# Blitz.Result

Source: https://blitz.hexdocs.pm/Blitz.Result.md

# `Blitz.Result`
[🔗](https://github.com/nshkrdotcom/blitz/blob/main/lib/blitz/result.ex#L1)

Result metadata for a completed command.

# `failure_kind`

```elixir
@type failure_kind() :: :exit | :startup_error | :timeout | :worker_crash
```

# `t`

```elixir
@type t() :: %Blitz.Result{
  args: [String.t()],
  cd: String.t() | nil,
  command: String.t(),
  duration_ms: non_neg_integer(),
  exit_code: non_neg_integer() | nil,
  failure_kind: failure_kind() | nil,
  failure_reason: String.t() | nil,
  id: String.t(),
  output_tail: [String.t()]
}
```

# `command_line`

```elixir
@spec command_line(t()) :: String.t()
```

# `failed?`

```elixir
@spec failed?(t()) :: boolean()
```

# `from_command`

```elixir
@spec from_command(Blitz.Command.t(), non_neg_integer(), non_neg_integer(), [
  String.t()
]) :: t()
```

# `startup_error`

```elixir
@spec startup_error(Blitz.Command.t(), non_neg_integer(), [String.t()], String.t()) ::
  t()
```

# `timeout`

```elixir
@spec timeout(Blitz.Command.t(), non_neg_integer(), [String.t()], timeout()) :: t()
```

# `worker_crash`

```elixir
@spec worker_crash(Blitz.Command.t(), non_neg_integer(), [String.t()], String.t()) ::
  t()
```

# mix blitz.test_state.prune

Source: https://blitz.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Blitz.TestState.Prune.md

# `mix blitz.test_state.prune`
[🔗](https://github.com/nshkrdotcom/blitz/blob/main/lib/mix/tasks/blitz.test_state.prune.ex#L1)

Prune compact Blitz test-state artifacts.

Usage:

    mix blitz.test_state.prune
    mix blitz.test_state.prune --store-dir /tmp/blitz-test-state

# mix blitz.workspace

Source: https://blitz.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Blitz.Workspace.md

# `mix blitz.workspace`
[🔗](https://github.com/nshkrdotcom/blitz/blob/main/lib/mix/tasks/blitz.workspace.ex#L1)

Run a configured Blitz workspace task from the current Mix project.

Usage:

    mix blitz.workspace <task> [task args]
    mix blitz.workspace <task> -j 4 -- [task args passed through verbatim]

# `mix blitz.workspace.impact`
[🔗](https://github.com/nshkrdotcom/blitz/blob/main/lib/mix/tasks/blitz.workspace.impact.ex#L1)

Usage:

    mix blitz.workspace.impact test --dry-run
    mix blitz.workspace.impact compile --base main --head HEAD
